passage:
survey — 调查
They had just finished a small survey about a new coffee shop, and the results looked great.

conclusion — 结论
The team decided to check their conclusion.

data — 数据
"We have data, but it is not complete data."

varied — 多样的
They would also ask two questions: "Do you drink coffee?" and "Would you buy coffee here every week?" This time, they wanted a bigger and more varied group.

percent — 百分比
The team leader, Maya, said, "If 80 percent of people say yes, then we should open the shop next month." Everyone agreed.

collect — 收集
They wanted to collect information from different types of people, not just office workers.

represent — 代表
They also wanted to represent the whole community better, so they chose places where many different people go.

decision — 决定
This helped them make a better decision about the shop.
